summary.en: Meet your natural breath, without a performance.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Sit in a way that feels supported. Keep your breathing ordinary.
Notice where you can feel it most easily: near the nose, the chest, or the belly.
Choose one place and stay with a few breaths.
There is no right depth or speed.
If focusing on breathing feels uncomfortable, notice your feet instead.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Notice the beginning of a natural breath in, and the way it turns into a breath out.
You do not need to stretch either part or hold your breath.
Follow just this one cycle. Then begin again with the next.
If your attention wanders, the next breath is a simple place to return.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Let breathing happen in the background.
Place your attention on the contact beneath your feet or your seat.
Notice pressure, warmth, or texture. You may feel very little, and that is fine.
Move attention gently between this contact and one natural breath.
You can choose whichever feels more comfortable.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Rest your attention on one place where breathing is easy to feel.
Sooner or later, a thought or sound may pull you away. The practice is not staying perfectly focused.
It is noticing that movement and returning without a struggle.
Each time you notice, begin with the breath that is already here.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Let one sound reach you without searching for its source.
Then notice one natural breath. Allow both to belong to the same moment.
You do not need a quiet room to practice.
If the sound is unpleasant, return to the steady contact beneath your feet rather than trying to push it away.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Imagine a small gap between two things you do each day.
Before opening a door, sitting down, or reaching for your phone, there may be room for one ordinary breath.
Practice that now. Notice your hands, let one breath come and go, and feel the support beneath you.
No special breathing pattern is needed.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: You have tried breathing, contact, and sound as places to return to.
Choose one that feels straightforward today.
Spend this quiet moment with it. When attention wanders, come back gently.
You can take this practice into an ordinary day, for one breath or a little longer, whenever you choose.

summary.en: A small pause between what happens and what you do.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Anger can be useful information, and nothing here asks you to get rid of it.
Notice where a strong feeling shows up in your body: your hands, jaw, chest, or somewhere else.
Simply feel that place. There is no need to change it.
Spend this quiet moment noticing how it feels right now.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Bring your attention to your feet, or wherever your body meets the seat.
Notice pressure, warmth, or the surface holding you.
You can press down gently if that helps you feel it. Let your breathing stay ordinary.
When the feeling pulls at your attention, come back to this steady contact for a few breaths.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Only if it feels comfortable, let one breath out be a little slower than the one before, as if you were fogging a window.
Then let your breathing return to its own pace.
You do not need to breathe in any special way.
If this is uncomfortable, skip it and keep noticing your feet.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: See if one plain word fits what is here: annoyed, tense, hurt, or tired.
If none fits, that is fine. A name does not have to be exact, and it is not a judgment.
Say the word quietly inside, then notice whether the feeling is a little easier to have beside you.
Take your time with this.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Recall a small moment that irritated you, without replaying all of it.
Imagine the time just before you answer.
Picture it as room for one ordinary breath, with your feet on the floor.
You are not deciding what to say. You are only noticing that a pause can exist there.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Check your hands, jaw, and shoulders. Choose one place that is holding more than it needs to.
Let it loosen by a small amount, without forcing anything.
If it tightens again, that is ordinary.
Notice that you can loosen it again, and spend this quiet moment with the difference.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: You have tried feeling your feet, a slower breath out, a plain name, and loosening one place.
Choose the one that felt most usable. Try it once now.
You can bring it to the moment before you reply, and leave it when it does not help.
Anger does not have to fade for a pause to be possible.

summary.en: Steadier attention for days when a lot is asked of you.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Before anything else, pause and feel your feet and the surface beneath you.
Let your back be held by the chair or wall behind you, if there is one.
You do not have to feel ready. It is enough to arrive as you are.
For the next few breaths, being here is the only task, and it is already happening.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Think of something coming up that feels large.
Look for the smallest next action, such as opening a book, reading one question, or writing one line.
You do not need to plan the rest.
Name that action once, then let your attention rest on your hands and one natural breath.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Pressure can show up as a fast heartbeat, a tight stomach, or shaky hands.
Notice one of these as a sensation, with its own size and edges.
It can be there while you sit. You do not have to make it leave.
Feel your feet, and let attention move between the sensation and this steady contact.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Listen for thoughts about results: what might go wrong, or what others will think.
Name them as forecasts, since they describe the future rather than this moment.
You do not need to argue with them.
Return to something you can check now, such as your feet, a sound, or the next breath.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Imagine the gap between two tasks.
Let your hands rest, look at something in the distance, and take one unhurried breath.
That is the whole reset. It can be short enough to fit into a busy day.
Practice it now, and notice what it is like to stop before you are worn out.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Think about a stretch of effort coming up.
Where could a brief rest belong: a walk, a glass of water, or a few minutes looking out a window?
Rest is not a reward you have to earn. It is part of how attention lasts.
Feel what it is like to give yourself this quiet moment now.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Choose one practice from this path to keep for pressure days: feeling your feet, naming the next small action, calling a thought a forecast, or a short reset.
Try it once now.
Use it before you begin something, and drop it if it does not help.
You are allowed to begin without feeling ready.

summary.en: A softer landing at the end of the day.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Find a supported position. Let your eyes stay open, or lower your gaze.
Notice three ordinary things around you.
Feel the surface carrying your weight.
There is no need to make your breathing deeper. Let it find its own pace.
For the next few moments, simply notice where your body meets the chair or bed.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Bring to mind one small thing that happened today, without retelling the whole day.
You do not need to solve it here.
Imagine setting it on a shelf until you choose to return to it. Feel your hands resting.
When another thought arrives, quietly name it thinking, then return to the weight of your hands.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Notice your jaw, shoulders, and hands.
Choose just one place where you could do a little less holding.
Do not force it to relax. Let a small amount of effort drop, if that feels comfortable.
Keep breathing naturally.
Spend this quiet moment noticing the difference between holding and letting the surface support you.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: If a task is circling in your mind, give it a short name, such as tomorrow or something to remember.
A name is enough; you do not need the whole story.
Let your attention return to a sound in the room. Thoughts may continue in the background.
Practice hearing one sound without chasing the next thought.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Look for one small comfort already here: a warm sleeve, a steady surface, or the dimness of the room.
Let your attention rest there. This does not have to change how you feel.
You are simply noticing one part of this moment.
When attention moves away, return gently to that small comfort.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Think of one ordinary action that can mark the end of your day.
It might be putting down your phone or turning off a lamp.
Choose something small enough to do without a plan. Notice what changes when you imagine doing it slowly.
For now, feel your feet or legs supported and let the next breath arrive on its own.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Recall the practices you tried: feeling support, naming a thought, or noticing a small comfort.
Choose the one that felt easiest to return to.
You do not need to keep them all. Try that one now in your own way.
There is no test at the end of this path.
A small practice can be enough for this evening.

summary.en: Small ways to rest when you have been carrying a lot.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Feel the chair, bed, or floor taking your weight.
Let it hold a little more of you than usual. You do not have to earn this rest.
For a few breaths, nothing needs to be produced, fixed, or answered.
Let your attention settle on the places where you feel supported, and let your shoulders be heavy.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Bring to mind one thing that has been asked of you lately: a task, a person, or a running list.
Do not try to solve it.
Just notice its weight, the way you would notice a bag on your shoulder.
Then imagine setting the bag beside you for a few minutes, and feel what your shoulders do.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Let this be rest without a purpose.
You are not trying to be more productive afterward.
Let your eyes soften and your hands stay open.
If a thought says you should be doing something, thank it for the reminder, and return to the feeling of being held by the surface beneath you.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Think of one small thing that eases you a little: warm water, a window, a soft sound, or a familiar song.
It does not have to be impressive.
Imagine having it for a few minutes today.
Notice what changes in your body when you picture it, and rest your attention there.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Tiredness often speaks quietly first: heavy eyelids, a tight neck, a long sigh.
Look for one signal in your body right now.
You do not need to explain it or fix it.
Practice listening to it the way you would listen to a friend, and let your next breath be unhurried.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Recall a small activity you once enjoyed without needing a result: watching clouds, humming, or stretching.
Let your body remember it a little.
You do not have to do it today.
Simply notice whether any part of you feels lighter at the thought, and stay with that for a quiet moment.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Choose one thing from this path to keep: feeling held, setting the weight down, a small refill, or listening for the signal.
Try it once now.
If tiredness stays heavy over time, talking with someone you trust or a health professional can be a good next step.
Rest in small pieces still counts.

summary.en: Gentle practice for attention in an ordinary day.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Let your gaze rest on an ordinary object nearby.
Notice its shape, one edge, and a small change in color.
There is nothing special to find. Feel your feet while you look.
If a thought arrives, let it be there and return to the object.
For a little while, this is the only thing you are choosing to notice.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Think of one task you may return to after this pause.
Make the next action smaller than the whole task.
It might be opening a document or reading one paragraph. You do not need to start it now.
Name that small action once, then return attention to your hands resting and your natural breathing.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Choose a simple point of attention: an object, a sound, or your feet.
When a thought interrupts, quietly say thinking.
You do not need to argue with it or finish its story. Return to your chosen point.
This is a practice in coming back, rather than keeping the mind empty.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Look at the space in front of you.
Notice one object you need for your next small action and one you do not need right now.
There is no need to tidy everything. If it feels useful, move just that second object aside.
Then pause and notice whether your gaze has a little less to follow.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Choose a very small movement, such as opening and resting one hand.
Do it slowly enough to notice the beginning and the end.
Let your breath keep its own pace. You are not trying to become slower at everything.
You are exploring what one deliberate movement feels like before returning to your day.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Recall a moment when your attention moved away from something today.
Leave out the judgment about what that means. Attention moves; now you can choose where it goes next.
Feel the support beneath you and name one small action you would like to return to.
Spend this quiet moment simply being here.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Consider the practices you have tried: looking closely, naming one next action, or returning without judgment.
Choose one to keep nearby. Try it once now, in a way that fits this moment.
You can use it briefly before a task, and leave it when it is no longer useful.
Your attention does not need to be perfect.

summary.en: Steadiness for rooms full of other people.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Before thinking about the room, feel your body in it.
Notice your feet, your back against a chair or wall, and the weight of your hands.
You do not have to look at ease.
Take a few natural breaths, and let your body be here first, before anyone asks for your attention.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Let your eyes move slowly around the space.
Notice one color, one source of light, and one object that has nothing to do with people.
Let each be simply what it is.
Looking at the room this way gives your attention somewhere steady to rest while others move and talk.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: You may notice a thought that others are watching or judging you.
Label it gently as a thought, one of many the mind makes in company.
You do not have to prove it right or wrong.
Bring your attention outward to a sound or an object, and let the thought stay in the background.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Choose one voice or sound nearby.
Listen to its rhythm and tone, not only its words. There is no need to respond yet.
When attention turns to how you look or what to say next, notice that, and come back to listening.
Listening is a way of being present that does not ask you to perform.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Imagine that you may take a short pause whenever you need one: a sip of water, a step to the side, or one slow breath before you answer.
A pause is an ordinary part of being among people.
Picture yourself taking one, feel your feet, and notice that you are still part of the room.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Think of one short thing you might say to someone: a greeting, a question, or your name.
Imagine saying it slowly, with a small pause after.
Silence between words is normal in any conversation.
Let your breath stay with you as you picture it, and notice what your body does.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: You have tried feeling your body, looking around, listening, and pausing.
Choose the one that felt most steady. Try it once now.
You can use it quietly in a room full of people, without anyone seeing.
Being among others can take effort, and you can go at the pace that fits you.

summary.en: Noticing the harsh voice, and trying a gentler one.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Listen for the voice that comments on you.
It may say you should have done more, or done it differently.
Notice its tone, and hold it as a thought that is here rather than a fact.
You do not have to argue with it. Feel your feet, and let your breath stay natural while you listen.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Bring to mind someone you care about who is in a situation like yours.
Imagine what you would say to them, and in what tone.
It may be quieter and slower than the voice you use with yourself.
Let those words, or just the tone, be here for a moment. Notice how it feels to be spoken to this way.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: If it feels comfortable, rest a hand on your chest, arm, or lap.
Notice its weight and warmth. You do not have to feel anything special.
This is a small way of showing your body that it is not alone.
If touch is uncomfortable, simply notice your hands resting where they are.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Think of something you are finding hard.
Many people know the feeling of falling short, even when they seem fine.
Struggling does not mean something is wrong with you. It is part of being someone who cares about things.
Let that thought sit with you for a few slow breaths.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Recall one thing from today that was decent, however small: a message you sent, a glass of water, or getting up.
There is no need to praise yourself.
Let it be counted quietly.
Notice how it feels to see one thing without weighing it against something else right away.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Bring to mind a small mistake, not the worst one. Notice how your body responds.
Then say inwardly, in a friend's tone, that this was a moment when things did not go as planned.
You do not have to fix it now.
Let the mistake sit beside you without becoming a verdict.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Choose a short, kind phrase that you could believe today, such as this is a hard moment, or I am doing what I can.
Say it inwardly once, slowly.
If it feels false, adjust the words until they are honest.
You can keep it for the moments when the harsh voice arrives.

summary.en: Gentle company for a loss you are carrying.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: You do not have to feel any particular way in this practice.
Find a position where your body is supported, and let the surface hold your weight.
If emotion is close, it can be here. If you feel very little, that is here too.
Take a few natural breaths, and let this be a place without expectations.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: If you like, notice whether the loss shows up in your body: a heaviness in the chest, a tightness in the throat, or an emptiness somewhere.
If it does, let your attention rest beside that place instead of pushing into it.
If it feels like too much, move to your feet.
Both are fine.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Let your breathing be ordinary, and let it keep you company.
You do not have to breathe in a way that changes what you feel.
Notice one breath in and one breath out as something that continues alongside everything else.
There is nothing to achieve here. Stay with a few breaths in this quiet moment.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Only if it feels right, bring to mind one small, ordinary thing about who or what you lost: a color, a sound, or a habit.
Let it be here without needing to hold every memory.
If it feels too tender, you can set it down and return to your breath.
You decide how close to go.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Feelings about a loss can arrive in waves, and they do not follow a schedule.
Notice whatever is here now, without deciding whether it should be smaller or bigger.
You may feel sadness, anger, relief, or nothing at all.
Each can be noticed and allowed to move in its own time.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Grief and rest can happen on the same day. So can a small smile, or a moment of ease.
Nothing about them takes away from what you have lost.
Feel the support beneath you, and let yourself have a moment of quiet without earning it.
You can return to the feeling whenever you choose.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: You have tried resting beside the feeling, following your breath, and remembering something small.
Choose one to keep.
Try it once now, at whatever distance feels right.
If the weight feels too heavy to hold alone, reaching out to someone you trust, or a professional, is a good next step.

summary.en: For days when something feels off and you cannot say what.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: You do not have to know what this is.
Sometimes a feeling has no name yet, and that is a normal place to start.
Find a position that feels supported, and let your breathing be ordinary.
For the next few breaths, the only task is to notice that something is here, and that you can sit with it.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Let your attention travel slowly through your body: your face, neck, shoulders, chest, stomach, and hands.
You are not searching for a cause.
Just notice temperature, tension, and heaviness in each place, and move on when you are ready.
Whatever you find is information, not a problem to solve.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: Imagine your inner state as weather: cloudy, windy, foggy, still, or changing.
You do not have to explain why the weather is what it is.
Weather passes through, and you are the sky it moves across.
Pick a word for it, or none, and rest with that image for a few breaths.

closing.en: Let your attention widen to the room. Notice one sound and the support beneath you. This practice is complete. You can close the app here, or return to your path when you choose.

text.en: If a word comes, try it lightly: heavy, tight, restless, flat, or something else.
See whether it fits a little, without insisting.
If it does not, let it go and try another, or none.
Take a few breaths between tries. Not having words is fine.
The feeling is still allowed to be here while you wait.

text.en: Alongside the unclear feeling, look for something steady or neutral: the light, a sound, warmth in your hands, or the support of the seat.
Let your attention rest there for a moment.
You are not pushing the feeling away.
You are noticing that more than one thing is true in this moment.

text.en: Ask yourself quietly what one small thing would be kind for the next hour.
It might be water, fresh air, a stretch, or a message to someone.
You do not need the feeling explained in order to look after yourself.
Choose one small thing, imagine doing it, and notice what your body says.

text.en: You have tried starting without a name, listening to the body, seeing weather, and choosing a kind next step.
Keep the one that felt easiest. Try it once now.
On a day when something feels off, you can begin here again.
If the feeling stays heavy, talking with someone you trust may help you find words together.
